text:
zoe-cs: Heads-up: Orchid Therapeutics pilot on Wed 09:30 UTC. During rehearsal they hit our us-east edge hard and APAC saw elevated p95. They asked for a short regional allowlist + temporary rate increase for sa-east-1 and eu-west-1. Renewal review in 18 days; CSM flagged exec concern.
hugo-ops: Ok. Need CIDRs, expected QPS, and partner vendors.
zoe-cs: Customer provided `203.113.5.12/32` and vendor InsightOps `203.113.8.0/24`. They expect bursts up to ~1100 qps for 20-30m, steady ~150 qps.
ishaan-net: Proposal: create allowlist AL-OR-21, TTL 8h auto-revoke, rate policy TEMP_SPIKE_8H max_qps 1500 with 30m burst window. Pin routing to sa-east-1 + eu-west-1 and pre-warm KV+embeddings caches. Need sec sign-off for vendor CIDR.
leah-sec: Security: require AUP & vendor contact; prefer mTLS for InsightOps but OK to proceed if they attest TLS + cert rotation within 72h. Add audit note to ticket CS-11900.
miles-ae: I'll brief account execs and prepare an ops runbook. If demo succeeds we push renewal from watch -> healthy.
hugo-ops: Commands ready, will schedule at 09:00 UTC to warm caches:
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{"name":"AL-OR-21","cidrs":["203.113.5.12/32","203.113.8.0/24"],"ttl":"8h","auto_revoke":true}
POST /policies/rate
{"name":"TEMP_SPIKE_8H","max_qps":1500,"burst_window_sec":1800,"regions":["sa-east-1","eu-west-1"]}
```
ops-bot: allowlist AL-OR-21 scheduled by hugo-ops at 2026-06-11T09:00:00Z
leah-sec: Approve conditioned on vendor attestation uploaded to CS-11900. If traffic shows signs of credential misuse we revoke immediately.
hugo-ops: Applied. AL in place and routing pinned. Initial smoke shows connections healthy. Warming done.
zoe-cs: Demo finished  latency p95 dropped from ~420ms -> 76ms in sa-east. Sustained peak ~980 qps for ~12m. Orchid requests a 3h ephemeral add for partner analytics CIDR `203.113.9.0/24` to finish processing.
leah-sec: 3h ephemeral OK with manual approval; require scoped token and audit. Post the partner CIDR in the ticket and I'll sign off.
hugo-ops: Added `203.113.9.0/24` TTL 3h, auto-revoke scheduled. AL-OR-21 updated. Monitoring shows stable results, no error spikes.
miles-ae: Demo successful, renewal moved to green/monitor. Zoe, please send short post-demo pulse and attach latency metrics to CRM.
zoe-cs: Will do. Thanks all :rocket:
